title: Short-time parametrix for the Fokker--Planck semigroup and applications
summary: We construct a short-time parametrix for the Fokker--Planck semigroup in Euclidean space. Among possible applications, we obtain smoothing and localization properties of the semigroup, the derivation of an approximate short-time polar decomposition for the semigroup, the construction of a parametrix of the resolvent, pseudospectral estimates, and estimates of the asymptotics of the number of eigenvalues of the Fokker--Planck operator.
